from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from tools.ml.climate_input import ClimateInputConfig, ClimateTrends, encode_climate_input
from tools.ml.climate_model_artifact import load_portable_model
from tools.ml.climate_policy import ClimateRulePolicy, apply_climate_safety, arbitrate_climate_action
from tools.ml.climate_scenarios import structured_training_episodes
from tools.ml.climate_simulator import CLIMATE_OUTPUT_NAMES, ClimateAction, ClimateSimulator
from tools.ml.climate_teacher import ClimateRolloutTeacher
root=Path('.')
model=load_portable_model(root/'reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.npz', root/'reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.json')
ratios={name:[] for name in CLIMATE_OUTPUT_NAMES}
print('INITIAL_ACTION_DIAGNOSTIC')
for episode in structured_training_episodes(scenarios_per_family=1, seed=91273):
    sim=ClimateSimulator(episode.scenario)
    profile=episode.first_profile
    sim.set_light_level(profile.light_level)
    state=sim.observe(add_sensor_noise=False)
    status={}
    features=encode_climate_input(sim.scenario,state,previous=ClimateAction(),trends=ClimateTrends(),status=status,config=ClimateInputConfig(targets=profile.targets,humidity_control_mode=profile.humidity_control_mode))
    pred=model.predict(features)
    ml=ClimateAction.from_mapping(dict(zip(CLIMATE_OUTPUT_NAMES,(float(v) for v in pred),strict=True)))
    rule=ClimateRulePolicy().choose(sim.scenario,state,profile,status=status)
    teacher=ClimateRolloutTeacher().choose(sim,profile.targets,humidity_control_mode=profile.humidity_control_mode,status=status).action
    arb=arbitrate_climate_action(ml,sim.scenario)
    safe=apply_climate_safety(arb.action,sim.scenario,state,profile,status=status)
    for name in CLIMATE_OUTPUT_NAMES:
        tv=getattr(teacher,name); mv=getattr(safe.action,name)
        if tv>0.05:
            ratios[name].append(mv/tv)
    fmt=lambda a:','.join(f'{v:.3f}' for v in a.as_tuple())
    print(f'{episode.family}: teacher=[{fmt(teacher)}] rule=[{fmt(rule)}] ml_raw=[{fmt(ml)}] ml_applied=[{fmt(safe.action)}] arb={arb.interventions} safety={safe.interventions}')
print('ACTIVE_ML_TO_TEACHER_RATIO')
for name,values in ratios.items():
    print(name, 'n=',len(values),'mean=',(sum(values)/len(values) if values else None),'values=',values)
